summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure by removing dead migration code from API and client, then get PR #344 merged by resolving all review comments.
summary.outcome: Gap closure plans (20-05, 20-06) executed successfully, all 9 verification truths passed, and all PR review threads resolved across 4 rounds — including a critical vault.rs init ordering bug fix, security fixes to recovery.html, and zero-length key validation added to both TypeScript and Rust.

repo: Phase 20 vault migration: server is now zero-knowledge — DB columns (encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, migrated_at) are fully dropped; all crypto material lives exclusively in IPFS v2 blobs

Orval API client regeneration does not automatically delete stale model files — manual removal of obsolete files (VaultResponseDtoEncryptedRootFolderKey, VaultResponseDtoEncryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey model files) and index.ts exports is required after schema changes
NestJS validation pipe rejects extra properties by default — SDK E2E test harness was still sending encryptedRootFolderKey/encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey on vault init, causing 400 errors in CI

Web client and desktop Rust client had divergent vault init ordering: web correctly published IPFS blob before backend registration, but desktop Rust called /vault/init first — if IPFS upload failed, backend had orphaned vault row
Recovery tool (recovery.html) inline deserializeVaultBlobV2 was a copy of the core library function but lacked the zero-length key_len rejection added to blob.ts

code.finding: POST /vault/init was called before IPFS upload + IPNS publish — reordered so backend registration only happens after successful IPFS operations to prevent orphaned vault rows
Zero-length key_len rejection added to both serializeVaultBlobV2 and deserializeVaultBlobV2 to enforce invariant in both directions
Zero-length key rejection added to both Rust serialize and deserialize paths to match TypeScript behavior — byte-identical cross-platform invariant
All 6 fetch() calls wrapped with fetchWithTimeout helper (AbortController, 15s for IPNS resolution, 30s for IPFS content fetch) to prevent hung requests

rootIpnsName validated against ^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$ before use in innerHTML; escapeHtml helper added for exportedAt and derivationInfo fields; encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey made optional in export-file path
Stale exports for VaultResponseDtoEncryptedRootFolderKey and VaultResponseDtoEncryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey remained after orval regeneration and needed manual removal
encryptVaultKeys import and crypto field usage in vault init request body were not cleaned up during Phase 20 execution — needed separate fix after CI failure

workflow: Outside-diff review comments on GitHub are easy to miss — they appear in the review body text rather than as inline thread annotations and won't show up in the standard reviewThreads GraphQL query
GSD gap closure mode (--gaps-only) correctly skips research phase and reads VERIFICATION.md gaps directly — planning and execution flow is identical to normal phases
Regression gate caught 143 prior-phase tests cleanly across 5 test suites before verification ran
CodeRabbit and Copilot reviews surfaced complementary issues — CodeRabbit caught security/input issues, Copilot caught symmetric validation gaps across language boundaries

friction: SDK E2E tests were not updated during plan execution (20-05/20-06) and only failed in CI — gap in the executor's awareness that E2E test fixtures need updating alongside DTO changes
Orval silently leaves stale model files behind after regeneration — no warning or cleanup, discovered only via CodeRabbit review comment
Outside-diff GitHub review comment (vault.rs init ordering) was invisible to the standard resolve-pr-reviews workflow and required manual URL lookup to discover
Verification file path lookup required multiple bash fallback commands due to working directory ambiguity between cipher-box and cipher-box-phase-20 roots
Plans were already committed by the planner agent before the orchestrator attempted to commit — double-commit attempt needed detection logic
open_items: 2 items need human verification in a live environment: (1) new user init publishes v2 blob to IPFS before API registration, (2) recovery tool IPFS-direct path with real vault and real IPFS gateway
Next phase is Phase 23 — /gsd:discuss-phase 23 or /gsd:plan-phase 23 is the suggested next step
Desktop Rust vault init reordering (vault.rs) should be covered by an integration test to prevent regression — currently only verified by code review
